title: 11. Sınıf İngilizce – 1. Dönem 1. Yazılı (OGM Yazılıya Hazırlanıyorum)

notes.summary: Bu, MEB OGM “Yazılıya Hazırlanıyorum” serisindeki 11. sınıf İngilizce 1. dönem 1. yazılı örneğidir. Altı soru vardır ve toplam 100 puandır: iş ilanlarını CV'lerle eşleştirme (9), ana fikir ve başlık (10 + 5), niyet mektubu yazma (25), geçmiş yetenek ve yetersizlik ifadeleri (12), metinden eş anlamlı cümle bulma (16) ve ilgi ile becerileri anlatan paragraf (23). Yazma soruları tek başına 48 puandır. Çalışırken önce ilan ve CV eşleştirmesini, ana fikir mantığını ve could / was able to ayrımını öğren; sonra niyet mektubunu ve 70-90 kelimelik paragrafı kendi elinle yazarak dene. Rubriği Türkçe, sorular İngilizcedir; yazarken her istenen bilgiyi ayrı bir cümleyle verdiğinde puan kaybetmezsin.

sections.title: Job ads: how to read requirements
sections.content:
Bir iş ilanını okurken önce aranan pozisyona (position), sonra şartlara (requirements) bak. Şartlar genelde üç türdür: deneyim (örneğin “minimum 1 year”, yani en az bir yıl), belge ya da ehliyet (a lifeguard certificate, a driving license) ve dil seviyesi (B1 level German). B1 ve B2 gibi harfler dil düzeyini gösterir ve B2, B1'den yüksektir.

Mantık eleme mantığıdır: bir aday ancak tüm şartları karşılıyorsa ilana uyar, tek bir eksik şart bile ilanı eler. Mesela bir ilan hem bir yıl deneyim hem de B tipi ehliyet istiyorsa, deneyimi olup ehliyeti olmayan aday o ilana uymaz. Eşleştirme sorusunda bir ilan fazladır ve her aday yalnızca bir ilana eşleşir, o yüzden kimseye uymayan ilanı bulmak işi kolaylaştırır.

sections.title: Matching CVs with ads: step-by-step
sections.content:
Eşleştirmede acele etme, sırayla git. Önce her ilanın şartlarını işaretle, sonra her adayın CV'sindeki ayırt edici belgeyi ya da deneyimi bul. En kolayı, benzersiz özelliği olan adayla başlamaktır, çünkü o seçildikçe kalan seçenekler azalır; son ilanı da eleme yoluyla doğrularsın.

Sorudaki sonuçlara bak. Ece'nin hayvan barınağında 18 aylık gönüllülüğü ve B sınıfı ehliyeti var, bu yüzden Happy Tails Pet Hotel (B) ilanına uyar. Kerem sertifikalı cankurtarandır (certified lifeguard), Blue Wave Leisure Centre (D) ilanını alır. Selin bir fırında 14 ay kasiyerlik yapmıştır, Sweet Corner Patisserie (A) ona uygundur. Lingua Kids Club (C) ise fazladır, çünkü kimsenin iki yıllık anaokulu deneyimi ve B1 Almancası yoktur. Cevabı harfle (A-D) ya da ilanın adıyla yazabilirsin, ikisi de kabul edilir.

sections.title: Job and career vocabulary
sections.content:
İş ve kariyer metinlerinde birkaç sözcük sürekli döner; onları anlamlarıyla birlikte bil. Bir işe başvurmak apply for, başvuran kişi applicant ya da candidate, açık pozisyon position veya vacancy, işveren employer, çalışan employee'dir. Part-time yarı zamanlı, full-time tam zamanlı demektir. Skill beceri, qualification nitelik, reference referanstır; entrepreneur ise yeni bir iş kurup riski üstlenen girişimcidir.

Cümlede şöyle kullanırsın: I'd like to apply for the position. Birinin bir işe uygun olduğunu be suitable for ya da be qualified for ile söylersin. Kişilik sıfatları (responsible, reliable, hard-working, friendly) ve communication skills (iletişim becerileri) CV ve mektuplarda çok geçer. CV bölümleri education, skills, experience ve interests'tir. Küçük tuzak: work experience sayılamayan bir isimdir, yani experiences demezsin.

sections.title: Main idea questions
sections.content:
Ana fikir, metnin tamamının verdiği mesajdır; tek bir ayrıntı değil. Doğru seçenek metnin başından sonuna kadar geçen fikri kapsar. Yanlış seçenekler genelde dört yoldan kendini belli eder: fazla genel olur, fazla dar olur (yalnızca bir ayrıntıyı söyler), metne ters düşer ya da metinde hiç olmayan bir bilgi verir.

Lina Demir metninde akış şöyledir: bir sorun fark eder, çözüm geliştirir, ilk denemelerden geri bildirim alır, şirket kurar ve uluslararası büyür. Bu akışın hepsini kapsayan ana fikir şudur: Lina atıkları azaltan pratik çözümler geliştirerek küresel başarı yakalamıştır. “Yalnızca”, “her” ya da “hiçbir şekilde” anlamına gelen only, every, without any gibi aşırı sözcükler çoğunlukla yanlış seçeneği ele verir. Seçeneği seçmeden önce kendine “bu metinde kanıtı var mı?” diye sor.

sections.title: Choosing a suitable title
sections.content:
Başlık, metnin ana fikrini kısa ve ilgi çekici söyler; yani başlık seçmek aslında ana fikri bulmaktır. Önce metnin neyi anlattığını bir cümleyle özetle, sonra buna uyan seçeneği ara. Anahtar kavramlar sana yol gösterir: Lina Demir metninde waste (atık), worth (değer) ve persistence (azim) geçer.

Lina atığı fark edip değere çevirdiği için uygun başlık “From Waste to Worth”tur. “A Business Without Challenges” başlığı metne terstir, çünkü ilk modeller sızdırıyordu ve temizlenmesi zordu. “A Quick Way to Make Money” ise metinle uyuşmaz, çünkü başarı sabır, sosyal sorumluluk ve çok denemeyle gelmiştir. Abartılı ya da metne ters başlıkları ele ve başlıkta ana sözcüklerin büyük harfle başladığını unutma.

sections.title: Entrepreneurs text: Lina Demir (content & vocabulary)
sections.content:
Metin, genç girişimci Lina Demir'i anlatır. Lina okulda atılan kâğıt bardakları fark eder ve bir geri dönüşüm kampanyası başlatır, ama asıl istediği atığı oluşmadan azaltmaktır (reduce waste). Üniversitede katlanabilir, yeniden kullanılabilir (reusable) bir bardak tasarlar; ilk modeller sızdırır, o da insanlardan geri bildirim (feedback) alıp daha güvenli bir sürüm üretir.

2019'da arkadaşlarıyla FoldFresh şirketini kurar (found – founded – founded). Önce yerel pazarlarda ve çevrimiçi satış yapar, kısa videolarla ürünü anlatır, kafeler, okullar ve etkinlik organizatörleriyle çalışır. Bugün farklı ülkelerde satış yapıyor ve ücretsiz atık azaltma atölyeleri veriyor. Lina'ya göre başarılı girişimci gerçek bir problemi belirler, insanları dinler ve fikrini geliştirir. Metindeki anahtar sözcükler persistence (azim) ve social responsibility'dir (sosyal sorumluluk).

sections.title: CV structure
sections.content:
CV (özgeçmiş) kısa, düzenli ve doğru bilgi içermelidir; amacı işverene “bu ilana uygunum” demektir. Bu örnekte üç ana bölüm var: Education (okul ve mezuniyet yılı), Skills (dil düzeyi, sertifikalar, ehliyet) ve Experience (süre ve yer). Kişisel bilgiler, ilgi alanları ve referanslar da eklenebilir.

Yazım için birkaç pratik kural: süreleri 18 months, 1 year, 2 years gibi açık yaz; dil düzeyini CEFR ile belirt (B1 level English); deneyimi kısa kalıplarla ver (volunteer at an animal shelter, personal trainer at a gym club). En önemli ilke, ilanın anahtar kelimelerini öne çıkarmaktır. İlan cankurtaran sertifikası istiyorsa bunu CV'nde görünür yere koy ve deneyimleri ilana göre sırala; en alakalı olan en üstte olsun.

sections.title: Letter of intent: structure
sections.content:
Letter of intent, belirli bir pozisyona neden başvurduğunu anlatan kısa resmî mektuptur. Yapısı sıralıdır: hitap (Dear Sir or Madam,), başvuru cümlesi (I am writing to apply for …), kişilik, eğitim, beceri ve deneyim, uygun olma gerekçesi ve kapanış. Bu yazılıda beş bilgi istenir ve her biri 5 puandır, toplam 25: position, personality, education, skills/experience ve why suitable.

Puan mantığı bellidir: her bilgi için ayrı bir cümle kurarsan her biri puan getirir; bir bilgiyi atlarsan o 5 puan gider, anlam bozukluğu varsa 1 puan düşer. Hayali bilgi kullanabilirsin, önemli olan İngilizce ve içeriktir. Resmî dili koru: I am writing to apply for…, I would be grateful…, I am confident that… Kapanışta tuzağa dikkat et: Dear Sir or Madam ile başladıysan Yours faithfully, adı biliyorsan Yours sincerely yazarsın.

sections.title: Letter of intent: useful phrases
sections.content:
Niyet mektubunda her bilgi için hazır bir kalıbın olursa zaman kazanırsın. Pozisyon için I am writing to apply for the … position at … . Kişilik için I am a friendly, responsible and patient person; başka sıfatlar da seçebilirsin: hard-working, creative, reliable. Eğitim için I am an 11th-grade student at … High School. Beceri ve deneyim için I can speak English well ve last summer I worked as a volunteer … gibi cümleler kurarsın.

Son bilgi uygunluk gerekçesidir ve en çok puan kazandıran yer burasıdır: I think I am suitable for this position because I have good communication skills and I enjoy working with young people. Burada because, since ya da so bağlaçlarını kullan. Püf nokta, ilanda ne isteniyorsa onu yazmaktır: ilan “communication skills” arıyorsa mektupta bu ifadenin geçmesi seni ilana bağlar.

sections.title: Past ability: could, was/were able to, was/were unable to, couldn't
sections.content:
Geçmişte bir şeyi yapabilmeyi iki yolla söylersin: could + yalın fiil ya da was/were able to + yalın fiil. Mesela She could play the piano very well when she was eight. Yapamadığını söylemek için couldn't + yalın fiil ya da was/were unable to + yalın fiil kullanırsın: Tom couldn't play a musical instrument, She was unable to sing well.

İki kalıp arasında ince bir fark var: genel, uzun süredir sahip olduğun yetenek için could, belirli tek bir olayda başarı için was able to tercih edilir. Her ikisinden sonra fiil yalın kalır (could swim, couldn't swim). Metindeki dört ifadeyi ayırırken kalıbın kendisine bak: could play the piano very well ve could swim and ride a bike yeteneği, was unable to sing well ve couldn't play a musical instrument yetersizliği gösterir. “Music” gibi tek başına isimler ifade sayılmaz.

sections.title: Past ability: classification tips
sections.content:
Metindeki numaralı ifadeleri “ability” ve “inability” diye ayırırken fiil kalıbına bak: could ya da was able to yeteneği, couldn't ya da was unable to yetersizliği gösterir. However ve but gibi karşıtlık sözcükleri de çoğu zaman yetersizliğin geldiğini haber verir. When she was eight ya da when he was young gibi zaman ifadeleri geçmiş olduğunu doğrular.

Asıl tuzak fazladan verilen ifadelerdir. “Interested in music” ya da “enjoy learning new skills” ilgi anlatır, yetenek değil; “good at sports” da bir yatkınlıktır ve yetenek kalıbına girmez. Bu yüzden onlar extra olur. Tabloya yazılacak ifadeler dörttür ve her doğru ifade 3 puandır, yani 4 × 3 = 12 puan alırsın. Kalıbı görmeden yalnızca anlama bakarsan fazlalıklara kanarsın.

sections.title: Preferences: prefer, would rather, be into, first choice
sections.content:
Bu soruda verilen cümlenin anlamını, metindeki aynı anlama gelen cümleyle eşleştirirsin; bunun için tercih kalıplarını tanımalısın. Prefer + isim ya da V-ing (Daniel prefers spending his free time indoors), would rather + yalın fiil (She would rather go cycling than stay at home), be into + isim ya da V-ing (He is really into music) ve enjoy + V-ing hep “bir şeyi tercih etmek ya da sevmek” anlatır.

Bu kalıplar birbirinin yerine geçebilir: would rather go … than stay … anlamca prefer going … to staying … demektir. First choice en çok tercih edilen şeydir, less interesting ise daha az ilgi çekici. She enjoys taking photographs; it helps her feel relaxed cümlesi de fotoğrafı rahatlattığı için sevdiğini söyler. Her cümle 4 puandır ve cevabı metinden olduğu gibi almalısın; kendi kelimelerinle yeniden yazarsan eşleşme bozulur.

sections.title: Paraphrasing and finding sentences
sections.content:
Q5'te sana bir cümle verilir ve sen metinde aynı anlama gelen özgün cümleyi bulursun. Yöntemi üç adımda uygula: önce verilen cümledeki anahtar sözcüğü seç (bike, pictures, guitar, reading), sonra metinde bunun eş anlamlısını ara (cycling, photographs, practices the guitar, reading is his first choice), sonunda bulduğun cümleyi metinden olduğu gibi kopyala.

Eş anlamlıları tanımak işin yarısıdır. Ride a bike ile go cycling, pictures ile photographs, calm ile relaxed aynı şeyi söyler. Yapı da değişir: prefers X to Y ile would rather X than Y, regularly ile usually, after the school day ends ile after school aynıdır. Finds reading more enjoyable than TV cümlesinin karşılığı da reading is his first choice, TV is less interesting olur. Cümleyi yapı olarak eksik yazsan bile puan düşmez, önemli olan doğru cümleyi bulmaktır.

sections.title: Writing a paragraph about interests and abilities
sections.content:
Q6'da 70–90 kelimelik tek bir paragraf yazarsın ve içerikte üç şey olmalı: sevdiğin hobiler, becerilerin ve takıma katkın; geçmişte öğrenmeye başladığın bir beceri; kulüp için düzenlemek istediğin atölye ve nedeni. Konuyu “then and now” mantığıyla kur: When I was ten, I started learning the guitar; at first I could only play simple songs. However, now I can play many songs. Böylece geçmişte could, şimdi can birlikte görünür.

Rubrik 23 puandır: içerik 3+3+3, organizasyon 4, kelime 4, dilbilgisi 4, görev (uzunluk ve stil) 2. Uzunluk 70–90 kelime olmalıdır; 60–69 ya da 91–100 kelime 1 puan, 60'tan az ya da 100'den fazla 0 puan getirir. At first, However, Now, Because, Also gibi bağlaçlar organizasyon puanını yükseltir. Takıma katkıyı da I listen carefully, I explain ideas clearly gibi cümlelerle göster.

sections.title: How to score full marks: exam strategy
sections.content:
Önce sınavın haritasını bil: Q1 9, Q2 15, Q3 25, Q4 12, Q5 16, Q6 23 puandır ve toplam 100 eder. Okuma sorularının (Q1, Q2, Q4, Q5) toplamı 52 puandır; yazma sorularının (Q3 ve Q6) toplamı 48'dir. Yazma yaklaşık yarı puan demek, o yüzden zamanın büyük kısmını oraya ayırmalısın.

Okurken kanıt cümlesini işaretle, böylece her cevabın bir dayanağı olur. Yazarken önce planı çıkar (Q3'te beş bilgi, Q6'da üç içerik başlığı), sonra her bilgi için ayrı bir cümle kur. Boş bırakılan bölüm 0 puandır, anlaşılır ama küçük hatalı cümle yalnızca 1 puan kaybettirir, ilgisiz cümle ise puan getirmez. Metinden kopyalamak yerine kendi cümleni yaz ve son iki dakikada kelime sayısını ve dilbilgisini kontrol et.

quiz.question: QUESTION 2.1 (10 pts) Read the text. Lina Demir is a young entrepreneur from Türkiye. When she was a high-school student, she noticed that hundreds of paper cups were thrown away at her school every week. She started a small recycling campaign, but she realised that collecting waste was not enough. She wanted to reduce waste before it was created. At university, Lina designed a reusable cup that could be folded and carried in a small bag. Her first models leaked and were hard to clean, so she asked students, café workers, and engineers for feedback. After many tests, she produced a safer and more practical version. In 2019, Lina and two friends founded a company called FoldFresh. They first sold their cups at local markets and online, and Lina used short videos to explain the waste problem and show the product. As interest grew, they began working with cafés, schools, and event organisers. Today, FoldFresh sells various reusable food and drink containers in different countries and gives free workshops about reducing waste. Lina believes successful entrepreneurs identify a real problem, listen to people, and improve their ideas. Her story shows how persistence and social responsibility can turn a small observation into an international business. What is the main idea of the text? Choose the best option.
options: Lina achieved global success by developing practical solutions to reduce waste.
Lina became successful because her first product worked perfectly without any testing.
FoldFresh became successful only because it sold products at local markets.
Every school recycling campaign becomes an international company.

quiz.category: Q2: Main idea and title

quiz.question: QUESTION 3 (25 pts) Read the job advertisement below. Imagine that you want to apply for the position. Write a short letter of intent. You may use imaginary information about yourself. SUMMER CAMP ASSISTANT WANTED. Green Valley Summer Camp is looking for a student assistant for its summer programme. We are looking for someone who: can speak English well, has good communication skills, enjoys working with young people, is friendly and responsible. Working period: July-August. In your letter, write about: the position you are applying for, your personality, your education, your skills and/or experience, why you are suitable for the position. Write at least 5 sentences.
quiz.correctAnswer: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to apply for the Summer Camp Assistant position at Green Valley Summer Camp. I am a friendly and responsible person, and I really enjoy working with young people. I am an 11th-grade student at Eskişehir Anatolian High School. I can speak English well, and last summer I worked as a volunteer helper at a children’s library. I think I am suitable for this position because I have good communication skills and I am always patient with children. Yours faithfully, Deniz Kaya
keyPoints: Why suitable for the position (5 points)
quiz.explanation: Her bilgiyi ayrı bir cümleyle ver: (1) I am writing to apply for…, (2) I am a friendly and responsible person, (3) I am an 11th-grade student at…, (4) I can speak English well and I have experience…, (5) I am suitable because…. Bilgi eksikse o bilgiden 5 puan düşer; bilgi var ama dilbilgisi/anlam hatası varsa (anlaşılıyorsa) 1 puan düşer; ilgisiz cümle puan getirmez. Hitap ve kapanışı unutma: Dear Sir or Madam / Yours faithfully.
quiz.category: Q3: Letter of intent

quiz.question: QUESTION 4 (12 pts) Read the text and write the numbers in the correct column. Some expressions are extra. Different Skills in the Past: When Lucy and her brother Tom were children, they had different interests and abilities(1). Lucy was interested in music(2) from an early age. She could play the piano very well(3) when she was eight, and she often played songs for her family. However, she was unable to sing well(4), so she preferred playing an instrument(5). Tom was quite different from his sister. He was good at sports and enjoyed spending time outdoors. He could swim and ride a bike(6) when he was young, but he couldn’t play a musical instrument(7). Now, they both enjoy learning new skills(8). Which numbered expressions show past ability and which show past inability?
quiz.correctAnswer: Past ability: 3 (could play the piano very well) and 6 (could swim and ride a bike). Past inability: 4 (was unable to sing well) and 7 (couldn’t play a musical instrument). Extra: 1, 2, 5, 8.
quiz.explanation: Fiil kalıbına bak: “could + V1” yetenek, “was unable to / couldn’t” yetersizlik gösterir. 1, 2, 5 ve 8 ilgi ve tercih bildirir (interests, interested in music, preferred, enjoy), yani extra’dır. Her doğru yerleştirme 3 puandır, toplam 12.
quiz.category: Q4: Past ability and inability

quiz.question: QUESTION 5 (16 pts) Find the original sentences in the text and write them under the statements below according to their meanings. Personal Choices of Close Friends: Mia and Daniel are close friends, but they have different preferences about how to spend their free time. Mia loves being outdoors. At weekends, she would rather go cycling in the countryside than stay at home. She also enjoys taking photographs of nature because it helps her feel relaxed. She isn’t very interested in indoor activities. Daniel, on the other hand, prefers spending his free time indoors. He is really into music and usually practices the guitar after school. He also likes science-fiction books. When he has some extra time, reading is his first choice, while watching TV is less interesting to him. Although Mia and Daniel have different preferences, they enjoy talking about their hobbies together. Statement: 1. Mia prefers riding her bike in rural areas to spending time at home at weekends. Which sentence in the text has the same meaning?
quiz.correctAnswer: At weekends, she would rather go cycling in the countryside than stay at home.
keyPoints: The original sentence with “would rather … than …”
quiz.explanation: Anahtar eşleşmeler: prefers X to Y = would rather X than Y; riding her bike = go cycling; rural areas = the countryside; spending time at home = stay at home. Her cümle 4 puandır ve cümle metinden alınmalıdır.
quiz.category: Q5: Paraphrasing

quiz.question: QUESTION 5 (16 pts) Find the original sentences in the text and write them under the statements below according to their meanings. Personal Choices of Close Friends: Mia and Daniel are close friends, but they have different preferences about how to spend their free time. Mia loves being outdoors. At weekends, she would rather go cycling in the countryside than stay at home. She also enjoys taking photographs of nature because it helps her feel relaxed. She isn’t very interested in indoor activities. Daniel, on the other hand, prefers spending his free time indoors. He is really into music and usually practices the guitar after school. He also likes science-fiction books. When he has some extra time, reading is his first choice, while watching TV is less interesting to him. Although Mia and Daniel have different preferences, they enjoy talking about their hobbies together. Statement: 2. Taking pictures of nature makes Mia feel calm, so she enjoys this activity. Which sentence in the text has the same meaning?
quiz.correctAnswer: She also enjoys taking photographs of nature because it helps her feel relaxed.
keyPoints: The original sentence about photographs and feeling relaxed
quiz.explanation: pictures = photographs; makes her feel calm = helps her feel relaxed; so she enjoys = she enjoys … because …. Neden-sonuç yönü değişse de anlam aynıdır.
quiz.category: Q5: Paraphrasing

quiz.question: QUESTION 5 (16 pts) Find the original sentences in the text and write them under the statements below according to their meanings. Personal Choices of Close Friends: Mia and Daniel are close friends, but they have different preferences about how to spend their free time. Mia loves being outdoors. At weekends, she would rather go cycling in the countryside than stay at home. She also enjoys taking photographs of nature because it helps her feel relaxed. She isn’t very interested in indoor activities. Daniel, on the other hand, prefers spending his free time indoors. He is really into music and usually practices the guitar after school. He also likes science-fiction books. When he has some extra time, reading is his first choice, while watching TV is less interesting to him. Although Mia and Daniel have different preferences, they enjoy talking about their hobbies together. Statement: 3. Daniel has a strong interest in music and regularly plays the guitar after the school day ends. Which sentence in the text has the same meaning?
quiz.correctAnswer: He is really into music and usually practices the guitar after school.
keyPoints: The original sentence with “really into music”
quiz.explanation: has a strong interest in = is really into; regularly = usually; after the school day ends = after school. Cümlede “practices” yazımı metinde böyledir; metindeki yazımı koru.
quiz.category: Q5: Paraphrasing

quiz.question: QUESTION 5 (16 pts) Find the original sentences in the text and write them under the statements below according to their meanings. Personal Choices of Close Friends: Mia and Daniel are close friends, but they have different preferences about how to spend their free time. Mia loves being outdoors. At weekends, she would rather go cycling in the countryside than stay at home. She also enjoys taking photographs of nature because it helps her feel relaxed. She isn’t very interested in indoor activities. Daniel, on the other hand, prefers spending his free time indoors. He is really into music and usually practices the guitar after school. He also likes science-fiction books. When he has some extra time, reading is his first choice, while watching TV is less interesting to him. Although Mia and Daniel have different preferences, they enjoy talking about their hobbies together. Statement: 4. When Daniel has free time, he finds reading more enjoyable than watching television. Which sentence in the text has the same meaning?
quiz.correctAnswer: When he has some extra time, reading is his first choice, while watching TV is less interesting to him.
keyPoints: The original sentence with “first choice … less interesting”
quiz.explanation: free time = some extra time; finds reading more enjoyable = reading is his first choice; than watching television = while watching TV is less interesting. Eşleştirme karşılaştırma yapısındandır.
quiz.category: Q5: Paraphrasing

quiz.question: QUESTION 6 (23 pts) Read the notice below on the noticeboard outside your school library. NEW AT OUR SCHOOL: THE HOBBY & SKILL CLUB – MEMBERS WANTED! We meet every Thursday after school. Members organise workshops for one another: coding, upcycling, calligraphy, podcasting and indoor gardening. Take up something new this term! To join, write a short paragraph about your interests and abilities and put it in the box outside the library. Write a paragraph (70–90 words) about your interests and abilities for the Hobby & Skill Club box. Use the following details: the hobbies and activities you enjoy, the skills you have, and how you contribute to a team (e.g. by listening to others or explaining ideas); a skill you started learning in the past (what you could do then and what you can do now); one workshop you would like to organise for the club, and why (photography, folk dance, speaking English).
quiz.correctAnswer: I enjoy playing the guitar and taking photographs, and I am also interested in coding. I am good at explaining my ideas in a team, and I always listen carefully to my teammates. When I was ten, I started learning the guitar. At first, I could only play a few simple chords, but now I can play several songs and perform at school concerts. I would like to organise a photography workshop for the club because I can teach beginners how to take better photos with their phones.
keyPoints: Content: past skill, then and now (3)
Grammar, past and present used correctly (4)
Task: one paragraph, 70–90 words, suitable style (2)
quiz.explanation: Rubriğe göre planla: (1) hobiler + beceri + takım katkısı, (2) geçmiş beceri: “When I was …, I started … At first I could … but now I can …”, (3) atölye + neden: “I would like to organise … because …”. Tek paragraf yaz, 70–90 kelime. Bağlaç çeşitliliği (at first, but, now, because, also) organizasyon puanını, could/can zaman geçişi dilbilgisi puanını getirir. 60–69 veya 91–100 kelime görevde 1 puan; 60’tan az ya da 100’den fazla 0 puandır.
quiz.category: Q6: Paragraph writing

quiz.question: Match each candidate with ONE job ad (one ad is extra). ADS: A. CITY LIBRARY – Part-time helper (shelving books). Requirement: Good Turkish and 6 months of library or school experience. B. SKY CYCLE SHOP – Part-time bike mechanic assistant. Requirement: 1 year of experience with bicycles. C. KIDS’ ART HOUSE – Part-time art assistant. Requirement: B1 level English and a drawing portfolio. D. HAPPY BUS TOURS – Part-time tour guide helper. Requirement: B2 level English and a first aid certificate. CANDIDATES: Aylin – B2 English, first aid certificate, 8 months as a volunteer at a tourist information desk. Barış – 14 months repairing bikes at his uncle’s shop, B1 English. Cemre – B1 English, drawing portfolio, 1 year of art classes.
quiz.correctAnswer: Aylin – D; Barış – B; Cemre – C. Extra: A.
quiz.explanation: Her aday için benzersiz şartı bul: first aid certificate + B2 English → D; bike repairing experience → B; drawing portfolio + B1 English → C. A ilanı kimsenin kütüphane deneyimi olmadığı için fazladır. Soru, Q1 ile aynı mantıkta çözülür.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q1: Job ads and CVs

quiz.question: Match each candidate with ONE job ad (one ad is extra). ADS: A. GREEN CAFE – Part-time barista assistant. Requirement: 1 year of cafe experience. B. TECH CLUB – Part-time computer lab helper. Requirement: Basic coding skills and B1 English. C. SWIM ACADEMY – Part-time pool helper. Requirement: A lifeguard certificate. D. FARM HOUSE – Part-time animal helper. Requirement: Driving license (B). CANDIDATES: Deniz – coding certificate, B1 English, helped at a school computer club for 1 year. Elif – lifeguard certificate, 2 years in a swimming team. Fırat – no driving license, 18 months as a waiter at a cafe.
quiz.correctAnswer: Deniz – B; Elif – C; Fırat – A. Extra: D.
quiz.explanation: Fırat’ın ehliyeti olmadığı için D elenir; kafe deneyimi A ile uyumludur. Deniz’in kodlama sertifikası ve B1 İngilizcesi B’yi, Elif’in cankurtaran sertifikası C’yi gösterir.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q1: Job ads and CVs

quiz.question: Write a short letter of intent (at least 5 sentences) for this ad. LIBRARY ASSISTANT WANTED. Central Library is looking for a student assistant for weekends. We are looking for someone who: is organised, likes reading, can use a computer, is polite and patient. In your letter write about: the position, your personality, your education, your skills/experience, why you are suitable.
quiz.correctAnswer: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to apply for the weekend Library Assistant position at Central Library. I am an organised and patient person, and I am always polite to people. I am an 11th-grade student at Atatürk Anatolian High School. I can use a computer very well, and I helped my school librarian in the last two years. I think I am suitable for this position because I love reading and I enjoy helping other students find books. Yours faithfully, Selin Aksoy
quiz.explanation: Beş bilgiyi beş cümleyle ver. İlanın istediklerini (organised, likes reading, computer, polite, patient) cevabında kullan; böylece “why suitable” kısmı ilanla bağlanır. Hayali bilgi serbesttir.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q3: Letter of intent

quiz.question: Write a short letter of intent (at least 5 sentences) for this ad. SPORTS DAY HELPER NEEDED. A primary school needs a high-school volunteer for Sports Day on 20 May. We need someone who: is energetic, can work in a team, likes children, speaks clearly. In your letter write about: the position, your personality, your education, your skills/experience, why you are suitable.
quiz.correctAnswer: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to apply for the Sports Day Helper position at your school. I am an energetic and friendly person. I study at Gazi Anatolian High School in the 11th grade. I can work well in a team because I play basketball for my school team, and I have helped my little cousins with their sports lessons. I believe I am suitable for this job because I like children and I speak clearly and kindly. Yours faithfully, Mert Demir
quiz.explanation: Mektup beş ayrı bilgi vermelidir. Ayrıntıları ilandan al: energetic, team, likes children, speaks clearly. Gramer: I can work …, I have helped …, I believe I am suitable… kalıpları puan kaybettirmez.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q3: Letter of intent

quiz.question: Rewrite the weak letter below and fix at least three mistakes. “Dear friend, I want job. I am very good person. I am student. I can speak english. I am suitable. Bye.”
quiz.correctAnswer: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to apply for the position at your company. I am a very friendly and responsible person. I am an 11th-grade student at Anatolian High School. I can speak English well and I have experience as a volunteer helper. I think I am suitable because I have good communication skills. Yours faithfully, Ali Yılmaz
quiz.explanation: Hatalar: “Dear friend” resmî değil; “I want job” eksik (a/the, apply for); “I am very good person” eksik article (a very good person); “english” büyük harfle English; “Bye” resmî kapanış değil. Düzeltirken beş bilgiyi tamamlamaya dikkat et.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q3: Letter of intent

quiz.question: Complete the table with the numbered expressions. “When Aylin was a child, she was interested in sports(1). She could run very fast(2) and she was able to swim 500 metres(3), but she couldn’t ride a bike(4) until she was ten. Her brother was unable to run fast(5) because he was often ill. He preferred reading books(6). Today, both of them enjoy cycling(7).” Write the numbers under past ability / past inability.
quiz.correctAnswer: Past ability: 2 (could run very fast), 3 (was able to swim 500 metres). Past inability: 4 (couldn’t ride a bike), 5 (was unable to run fast). Extra: 1, 6, 7.
quiz.explanation: “could”, “was able to” yetenek; “couldn’t”, “was unable to” yetersizlik ifadesidir. “interested in sports”, “preferred”, “enjoy” ilgi bildirir ve extra’dır.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q4: Past ability and inability

quiz.question: Write four sentences about your own childhood: two about things you could do and two about things you couldn’t do. Use both “could/couldn’t” and “was/were able to / unable to”.
quiz.correctAnswer: When I was six, I could ride a bike. I was able to read short stories at the age of seven. I couldn’t swim until I was nine. I was unable to cook anything when I was a child.
quiz.explanation: Kalıplar: could + V1; was able to + V1; couldn’t + V1; was unable to + V1. Belirli bir zaman ifadesi (when I was six) eklemek geçmişi netleştirir.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q4: Past ability and inability

quiz.question: Find the original sentence in the text. TEXT: Kaan and Zeynep are cousins. Kaan is keen on gaming and usually spends his evenings playing online games. Zeynep, however, would rather read a novel than sit in front of a screen. At weekends, she also likes baking cakes because it helps her relax. Statement: Zeynep chooses reading a book instead of staring at a screen.
quiz.correctAnswer: Zeynep, however, would rather read a novel than sit in front of a screen.
quiz.explanation: chooses X instead of Y = would rather X than Y; staring at a screen = sit in front of a screen. Sorunun mantığı Q5 ile aynıdır.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q5: Paraphrasing

quiz.question: Find the original sentence in the text. TEXT: Kaan and Zeynep are cousins. Kaan is keen on gaming and usually spends his evenings playing online games. Zeynep, however, would rather read a novel than sit in front of a screen. At weekends, she also likes baking cakes because it helps her relax. Statement: Kaan has a strong interest in video games and often plays them at night.
quiz.correctAnswer: Kaan is keen on gaming and usually spends his evenings playing online games.
quiz.explanation: has a strong interest in = is keen on; video games = gaming; often = usually; at night = in the evenings. Eş anlamlı kalıpları bulmak için anahtar kelime eşleştir.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q5: Paraphrasing

quiz.question: Find the original sentence in the text. TEXT: Kaan and Zeynep are cousins. Kaan is keen on gaming and usually spends his evenings playing online games. Zeynep, however, would rather read a novel than sit in front of a screen. At weekends, she also likes baking cakes because it helps her relax. Statement: Zeynep enjoys making cakes on weekends since this activity calms her.
quiz.correctAnswer: At weekends, she also likes baking cakes because it helps her relax.
quiz.explanation: making cakes = baking cakes; calms her = helps her relax; since = because. Neden bildiren bağlaçlar birbirinin yerine kullanılabilir.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q5: Paraphrasing

quiz.question: Write a paragraph (70–90 words) about your interests and abilities for a school Art Club. Include: hobbies and a team contribution; a skill you started in the past (then and now); one workshop you would like to organise and why.
quiz.correctAnswer: I enjoy drawing, listening to music and playing chess. In a team, I share my ideas clearly and I always help others when they are stuck. Two years ago, I started learning how to paint with watercolours. At first, I could only paint simple flowers, but now I can paint landscapes and portraits. Also, I can mix colours in a creative way. I would like to organise a watercolour workshop for the club because many students want to try something relaxing and I can teach them the basic techniques.
keyPoints: Linkers: at first, but, also, because
quiz.explanation: Rubriğin yedi ölçütünü kapsa: üç içerik başlığı (3+3+3), bağlaçlar, kelime, dilbilgisi, uzunluk. Bu örnek yaklaşık 90 kelimedir; kendi cevabında kelime sayısını kontrol et.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q6: Paragraph writing

quiz.question: Write a paragraph (70–90 words) about your interests and abilities for a Coding Club. Include a past skill (then and now) and a workshop idea.
quiz.correctAnswer: I am interested in coding, video editing and table tennis. I am good at solving problems, and in a team I explain my ideas step by step. When I was twelve, I started learning Scratch. At first, I could only move a cat on the screen, but now I can write small games in Python. I would like to organise a game design workshop because many students love games and I can show them how to create one in simple steps.
quiz.explanation: Geçmiş: started, could only; şimdi: can write. Bağlaçlar: when, at first, but, now, because. Bir paragraf; 70–90 kelime hedefle.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q6: Paragraph writing

quiz.question: Read and answer. TEXT: Elif noticed that her school canteen threw away a lot of bread every day. She asked the canteen staff what happened to the leftover bread and learned that no one wanted it. She started a small project: students could buy leftover bread at a cheaper price at the end of the day. Later, other schools joined the idea. What is the main idea of the text? (One sentence)
quiz.correctAnswer: Elif solved a food waste problem at her school with a practical idea that other schools also adopted.
quiz.explanation: Ana fikir, metnin bütününü kapsar: problem (ekmek israfı), çözüm (indirimli satış) ve yayılma. Yalnızca “Elif asked canteen staff” gibi bir ayrıntı ana fikir olmaz.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q2: Main idea and title

quiz.question: Complete the sentences using “could”, “couldn’t”, “was able to” or “was unable to”. (a) When Tom was five, he ____ swim, so his parents always stayed next to him in the pool. (b) She ____ climb the tree yesterday although it was very tall. (c) Ali ____ play chess at the age of six. (d) I ____ understand the lesson because the room was too noisy.
quiz.correctAnswer: (a) couldn’t / was unable to swim; (b) was able to climb; (c) could play; (d) was unable to / couldn’t understand.
keyPoints: (b) was able to for a single success
quiz.explanation: Bu bölümde bağlama bak. (b) tek bir olayda başarı olduğundan was able to doğrudur. (d) gürültü yüzünden anlayamama olumsuzdur. (a) için “parents stayed next to him” yüzme bilmediğini gösterir, bu yüzden couldn’t kullanılır.
quiz.category: Ek alıştırma · Q4: Past ability and inability

options: A student with a driving license and a pet shop job
A student with B2 English and a bakery cashier job
A student who is a certified lifeguard
A student with 2 years in a kindergarten
quiz.explanation: İlanın tek şartı cankurtaran sertifikasıdır. Diğer adaylarda bu sertifika yoktur.

quiz.question: Which requirement is a qualification (not experience)?
quiz.explanation: Sertifika bir nitelik/belgedir. Diğer seçenekler süre belirten deneyimlerdir.

quiz.question: “I am writing to apply for the position of …” belongs to which part of a letter of intent?
quiz.explanation: Bu kalıp mektubun açılış bölümünde başvurulan pozisyonu belirtir. Kapanış Yours faithfully ile yapılır.

quiz.question: Choose the best closing for a letter that starts with “Dear Sir or Madam”.

quiz.question: Which sentence is the best topic sentence for a paragraph about interests?
options: Photography is a type of art.

quiz.question: Explain in Turkish or English why “She prefers reading to watching TV” and “She would rather read than watch TV” have the same meaning.

QUESTION 2 (15 pts)
Read the text and answer the following questions.
Lina Demir is a young entrepreneur from Türkiye. When she was a high-school student, she noticed that hundreds
of paper cups were thrown away at her school every week. She started a small recycling campaign, but she realised
that collecting waste was not enough. She wanted to reduce waste before it was created.
At university, Lina designed a reusable cup that could be folded and carried in a small bag. Her first models leaked
and were hard to clean, so she asked students, café workers, and engineers for feedback. After many tests, she
produced a safer and more practical version.
In 2019, Lina and two friends founded a company called FoldFresh. They first sold their cups at local markets and
online, and Lina used short videos to explain the waste problem and show the product. As interest grew, they began
working with cafés, schools, and event organisers.
Today, FoldFresh sells various reusable food and drink containers in different countries and gives free workshops
about reducing waste. Lina believes successful entrepreneurs identify a real problem, listen to people, and
improve their ideas. Her story shows how persistence and social responsibility can turn a small observation into an
international business.
1. What is the main idea of the text? Choose the best option. (10 pts)
 a. Lina became successful because her first product worked perfectly without any testing.
 b. Lina achieved global success by developing practical solutions to reduce waste.
 c. FoldFresh became successful only because it sold products at local markets.
 d. Every school recycling campaign becomes an international company.
2. Choose the most suitable title and put a tick (✔ ). (5 pts)

Personal Choices of Close Friends
Mia and Daniel are close friends, but they have different preferences about how to spend their free time. Mia loves
being outdoors. At weekends, she would rather go cycling in the countryside than stay at home. She also enjoys taking
photographs of nature because it helps her feel relaxed. She isn’t very interested in indoor activities. Daniel, on the
other hand, prefers spending his free time indoors. He is really into music and usually practices the guitar after school.

interesting to him. Although Mia and Daniel have different preferences, they enjoy talking about their hobbies together.
1. Mia prefers riding her bike in rural areas to spending time at home at weekends.
2. Taking pictures of nature makes Mia feel calm, so she enjoys this activity.
3. Daniel has a strong interest in music and regularly plays the guitar after the school day ends.
4. When Daniel has free time, he finds reading more enjoyable than watching television.
